change_summary: Ran a runtime-only monkeypatch of `portfolio_engine.size_signals()` that counted same-day `breakout_long` candidates after the accepted A+B ranking stack, then applied a breakout-only risk multiplier whenever the candidate count met a threshold. Screened `count >= 2` and `count >= 3` triggers with multipliers `0.5x / 0.25x / 0.0x` across the deterministic late / mid / old OHLCV snapshots. No repository trading logic was kept after measurement.
component: runtime-only monkeypatch of `quant/portfolio_engine.py` sizing path (rolled back; no repo trading logic changed)

delta_metrics.note: Raw same-day breakout crowding failed the majority-window test. Every `count >= 2` variant improved only the oldest weak window and regressed both the dominant late-strong window and the middle weak-bull window. The stricter `count >= 3` family was a strict null across all three windows because the state was too rare to matter.

hypothesis: If breakout fragility partly comes from same-day breakout crowding rather than stock-local quality alone, then a simple forward-looking cohort-composition rule should help: when the daily candidate set contains multiple `breakout_long` names, shrink breakout risk budget before entry. A valid rule must preserve the dominant late-strong window while improving at least one weaker window, and it should outperform the accepted A+B stack on a majority of the deterministic late / mid / old snapshots.
next_retry_requires: Do not retry breakout-health rules built only from raw same-day breakout candidate count or nearby count thresholds

If breakout cohort composition is revisited, require a richer forward-looking proxy than count alone, such as cohort quality dispersion, sector clustering with stronger evidence, or event-linked context
Prefer a different unblocked alpha branch unless new data creates a clearer present-tense test for breakout crowding
notes: This stayed a single-causal-variable experiment: only breakout risk budget changed, keyed off the same-day breakout candidate count seen before entry. Entries, exits, ranking, and all accepted cohort rules remained unchanged. The runtime monkeypatch was discarded after measurement.

selector.deployment: apply breakout-only risk multiplier when count >= threshold
selector.state_variable: same-day breakout candidate count after accepted ranking stack

rejection_reason: Rejected on Gate 4 multi-window stability. Simple breakout candidate count is too blunt a proxy for breakout health: it removes useful convexity in the strong and middle windows while providing only a small rescue in the oldest weak window, and the stricter threshold never fires enough to become a real rule.
